title: Pickleball Muck
style: Pop punk and skate punk. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted power chords in the verses and open, ringing chords in the choruses. A bright, overdriven bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riffs. High-energy drums feature a fast punk beat with rapid snare hits and consistent crash cymbal accents. Male vocals are delivered with a gritty, melodic punk snarl, including layered harmonies during the chorus. The tempo is 180 BPM in the key of E major. The arrangement features sudden stops and starts, with a brief half-time breakdown before the final chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[fast punk drums, distorted electric guitar riff, bass enters]

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted guitar]
Heavy feet stuck
How am I getting out of this muck? I'm going
[vocal ad-lib] (Bum-bum-bum-bum-bum)
I'm broke
[vocal ad-lib] (Bum-bum-bum-bum-bum)
Abandoned the capsizing boat
Body screaming, head in a cloud
Shout it to rooftops, shout it out loud
I'm gonna play [guitar chords open up]
I'm gonna play

[Chorus]
[full band, driving energy]
Always playing at your best
And all you want to do is rest
It's my pickleball lust
It's not a maybe
It's a must

[Verse 2]
[palm-muted guitar returns]
Sometimes it's like winner take all
Wave a hand and sometimes you want to stick your head in the sand
Story be told, one thing is true
I have a love [guitar chords open up]
And pickleball, that's you
